description: 2N5088 high-gain, low-noise NPN (hFE 300-900 at 100 µA; VCEO 30 V), our fit to Fairchild's sheet

source.licence: Our own model fitted to the maker's data sheet (D-163): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.vceo: Central Semiconductor 2N5088/2N5089 data sheet (R1, 20 June 2016), Maximum ratings: VCEO 30 V
rating_sources.ic: Central Semiconductor 2N5088/2N5089 data sheet (R1, 20 June 2016), Maximum ratings: IC 50 mA DC

package.name: TO-92 (EBC)
package.source: Central Semiconductor 2N5088/2N5089 data sheet (R1, 20 June 2016), page 2 lead code

fit.sheet: Fairchild 2N5088/2N5089/MMBT5088/MMBT5089 data sheet, Rev A (2001; onsemi's copy)
fit.figure: Typical Pulsed Current Gain vs Collector Current (25 °C, VCE = 5 V); Base-Emitter ON Voltage vs Collector Current (25 °C); Collector-Emitter Saturation Voltage vs Collector Current (β = 10, 25 °C); Input and Output Capacitance vs Reverse Bias Voltage (Cte); the same figure (Cob); Contours of Constant Gain Bandwidth Product: the 175 MHz contour's lowest point, 8 mA at VCE = 3.7 V
fit.method: Gummel-Poon (scripts/fit_models.py). IS, NF, BF, ISE, NE, IKF, NKF and RE by least squares on the hFE and VBE(on) curves at VCE = 5 V together (points: the curves read at 1-2-5 steps; the hFE curve times 0.9466, see note); no Early voltage (VAF left out): the sheet gives no output admittance or output curves, so none is set (ngspice's default). BR, ISC, NC and RC by least squares on the VCE(sat) curve, the hFE points held, NR = NF, at IC/IB = 10. CJE, VJE, MJE from Cibo and CJC, VJC, MJC from Cobo against reverse voltage. TF from fT 175 MHz at 8.07 mA (Contours of Constant Gain Bandwidth Product: the 175 MHz contour's lowest point, 8 mA at VCE = 3.7 V), less the junctions' charging time. Fitted curves are matched within 1.6 % (hFE), 0.7 mV (VBE) and 4.8 mV (VCE(sat)). RB, VAR, TR and the temperature terms are ngspice's defaults: the sheet doesn't pin them
fit.note: The sheet draws one typical gain curve for both parts (548.9 at 100 µA). Its shape is kept and its level set to the geometric middle of this part's 100 µA range (300 to 900: 520), as for the JFETs' ranges (D-161, D-163). The curve falls steeply past 20 mA (44 at 100 mA, times the same factor); NKF, the knee's exponent, follows it
